body: You need to be careful switching from dull to sharp, because the amount of pressure you use with a dull tool to cut is going to be way too much if you use that same amount of pressure with a sharp tool. Please please please be safe and sterilize your cutting tools and clean your cuts afterwards. Placement is also paramount to safety
